name: Automatic Skill Selector
description: Before the run, one configured model picks the best existing skill for the task; when nothing fits or the topic is narrow, it reads arXiv and builds a new skill with its own roles and sources. The council then runs on the Default configuration's models.

stages.title: Skill scout
stages.text: The decision model reads the task and the catalogue of every skill - bundled and kept - and answers with the best fit, or asks for a new skill when none genuinely covers the subject.

stages.title: arXiv research
stages.text: For a new skill the selector searches arXiv for the task's literature, ranks the papers by relevance and hands the top ones to the role generator.

stages.title: Skill author
stages.text: The role generator writes the new skill's roles, synthesis prompt and sources from that reading, and keeps it in the library like any drafted skill.

stages.title: Role pick
stages.text: The single role that best fits this exact task is chosen and moves to the front of the council's participant order.

stages.title: Council
stages.text: The picked or freshly built skill runs the regular multi-model consensus - on the Default configuration's models, whatever the composer's current pool is.
